content.short: A DAO that performs decentralized smart contract audits completely independently and free from any conflicts of.
content.description: Smart Contract Audit Token is a new audit paradigm that reinvents the way audits are selected, performed, and financed. We solve audits inherent problem: the lack of independence and conflict of interest that comes from paying for an audit service. As we have seen with Enron, Tyco, and countless others, the possibility always exists for an auditor to commit fraud to keep their client happy. With Smart Contract Audit Token, the token holders choose the projects they care for and want audited.
content.meta: Find out about Smart Contract Audit Token (DAO) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
